text: The Winline bookmaker is run by OOO Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS (UK NKS), in which Andrey Myslivtsev holds the largest share, 45%.

source.name: Stavka.tv — Vinлайн: кто основатель и владелец (Winline: who is the founder and owner)
source.quote: Компания входит в ООО «Управляющая компания НКС» с уставным капиталов 120 миллионов рублей. Основной долей владеет Андрей Мысливцев.
source.note: Russian text; translation: 'The company is part of OOO Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS with charter capital of 120 million roubles. The main share is held by Andrey Myslivtsev.' The same page lists shareholders: Myslivtsev 45%, Egorchenko 20%, R. Yusupov 16%, Grishkin 15%, L. Yusupova 4%, and lists HC Traktor among the clubs Winline partners with in 2026.
